inc.h2: What's in a Disruptive Dodo brand.

items.p: We ask about your business, your customers, the tone you want and the brands you like or don't. Everything we design starts from your answers.
Three different directions, each with its logo and colour palette, shown in use. You pick the one that feels like your business.
We refine the direction you chose with your feedback, until the logo works small on a phone and large on a sign.
A palette and a set of fonts that work together on screens and in print, with the codes your printer and your web team need.
A short guide that shows how to use your logo, colours and type, and what to avoid, so everyone who works on your brand gets it right.
A few clear rules for your words: your tone, the languages you use, and the phrases that sound like you.
Your logo in every version: colour, black and white, for screens and for print, ready to send to a printer or a web designer.
Your new look applied to your social media profiles and the documents you use every day. [Business cards, email signature, signage and packaging, to confirm]

choose.h2: How to choose a branding agency in Mauritius.

items.p: A good agency asks about your business and your customers before it draws anything. A logo made without questions is a guess.
A logo alone isn't a brand. Check that you get the colours, the fonts, the rules to use them and the files in every format.
Once the work is paid, the logo and the source files should be yours. Ask for that in writing.

items.h: Look at their brands in real life
items.p: A logo can look good on a screen and fail on a sign or a phone. Ask to see brands they made, in use.

fl.h2: Your brand is how people recognise you.
fl.p: Your brand shows up on your website, your posts, your ads and every message you send. In Fledge, it is set up once and used the same way everywhere, so people recognise you and trust you before they ever get in touch.

items.q: How much does a logo cost in Mauritius?
items.a: It depends on what you need: a logo alone, or a full identity with colours, typography and a brand book. After a free growth call, we send a fixed price before any work starts.
[About 3 to 4 weeks from the first call to the final files, to confirm.] We agree the dates with you before we start.

items.q: Do you help choose a business name?
items.a: No. The name is yours: you choose it and you register it. We start from it and design everything around it.

items.q: Who owns the logo and the files?
items.a: [You do. Once the project is paid, the logo and every file are yours. To confirm.]

items.q: How many changes can I ask for?
items.a: [Number of rounds of changes, to confirm.] We agree it before we start, and we ask the right questions first so the options are close from the start.

items.q: Can you refresh our existing brand?
items.a: Yes. We keep what your customers already recognise and modernise the rest, so you look current without starting from zero.
Your logo in colour, black and white, as vector files for print and PNG files for screens, the colour codes for print and screen, and your brand book as a PDF.

items.q: Is branding worth it for a small business?
items.a: A clear look that stays the same everywhere makes a small business look established, and it is often the first thing customers judge. It also makes every post, ad and page look like it comes from the same place.
